lines: I want you to smile as if a clear breeze were tickling your cheek.
Shall we walk only along the flower path?
I pray it will be enough if our hearts remember, even if we are separated.
I pray and pray and pray.
Tomorrow will come again, a tomorrow with you.
I close my eyes thousands of times, and shed stars.
I gently hid away the days that were still warm.
My rightful place.
Tonight, I will show you an impossible, an impossible number of stars.
Because I want you to smile and say, "It's just like a dream, just like a dream."
That is a charm, my yearning for you.
Feelings that twinkle more than the number of stars.
Tonight, I will show you an impossible, an impossible number of stars.
Because I want you to smile and say, "It's just like a dream, just like a dream."
That is a charm, my yearning for you.
A wish I send to you, twinkling more than the number of stars.
You hide away a heart that does not heal even as time passes.
But you smile only before me.
I remember the dreams you lost for all eternity.
I will pray and pray and pray for all of them, and deliver them.
I am not afraid, but it is a place I cannot see.
So hold that hand, hold that hand, and wait.
Tonight, I will show you an impossible, an impossible number of stars.
Because I want you to smile and say, "It's just like a dream, just like a dream."
That is a charm, my yearning for you.
Feelings that twinkle more than the number of stars.
Tonight, I will show you an impossible, an impossible number of stars.
Because I want you to smile and say, "It's just like a dream, just like a dream."
That is a charm, my yearning for you.
Twinkling more than the number of stars, twinkling even more.
Twinkling even more, feelings.
Feelings.
